ko.title: [소매유통 101 #12] 당신의 근처 가게가 이제는 창고이기도 하다

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > 옴니채널 소매유통은 고객이 여러 분리된 채널 대신 하나의 브랜드에서 쇼핑한다는 의미입니다 — 이는 인벤토리, 고객 데이터, 그리고 배송이 내부적으로 통합되어야만 가능합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: 소매업체들은 과거에 채널별로 생각했습니다.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: 가게는 하나의 사업, 웹사이트는 또 다른 사업, 카탈로그나 콜센터는 또 다른 사업이었습니다.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: 각각 자신만의 인벤토리 풀, 자신만의 가격 정책, 때로는 자신만의 손익계산서와 상사를 가지고 있었습니다.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: 이것이 **멀티채널** 소매유통입니다: 같은 브랜드로 들어가는 여러 개의 문, 하지만 그 문들은 서로 통신하지 않습니다.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **옴니채널**은 관점을 뒤집습니다.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: "각 채널이 얼마나 잘 작동했는가?"를 묻는 대신, "고객의 입장에서 이것이 어떻게 보일까?"를 묻습니다.

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: 쇼퍼는 절대 *지금 내가 모바일 채널에 있다*고 생각하지 않습니다. 그들은 휴대폰에서 광고를 보고, 노트북에서 리뷰를 읽고, 가게에서 상품에 손을 대고, 그 순간 가장 쉬운 방식으로 구매합니다.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: 옴니채널은 모든 그 접점들이 하나의 가게처럼 작동하게 만드는 운영 모델입니다.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: 일반적인 약자는 **O2O — 온라인에서 오프라인으로**, 그리고 다시 돌아오는 것입니다.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: 온라인 수요는 사람들을 물리적 위치로 끌어당기고(앱에서 주문, 카운터에서 픽업), 물리적 위치는 온라인 수요를 충족시킵니다(매장 재고에서 주문을 배송, 서비스 데스크에서 웹 반품을 받음).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: 어려운 부분은 가게 앞이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: 그것은 뒷단 시스템입니다.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: 세 가지가 통합되어야 합니다:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **인벤토리 가시성.** 무엇이 보유되어 있고 어디에 있는지에 대한 하나의 공유된 뷰. 웹사이트가 신시내티의 매장에 있는 3개의 재킷을 볼 수 없다면, 그것들을 팔 수 없습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **고객 데이터.** 채널 전체에 걸친 하나의 프로필 — 구매, 충성도 포인트, 반품, 저장된 장바구니. 그렇지 않으면 현장의 직원은 고객이 20분 전에 온라인에서 무엇을 했는지 알 수 없습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **배송 논리.** 주문별로 어느 노드가 이를 처리할지 결정하는 규칙: 배포 센터, 근처 매장, 또는 직접 배송하는 판매자.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: 이 세 가지를 제대로 하면 픽업, 커브사이드, 무한 통로, 그리고 쉬운 반품을 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: 이를 건너뛰면 "옴니채널"은 단지 상점 위치 찾기가 있는 웹사이트일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: 알 가치가 있는 두 가지 행동 용어가 있습니다.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **쇼우루밍**은 가게에서 상품을 살펴본 후 온라인에서, 보통 경쟁사에서 구매하는 것입니다.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **웹루밍**은 그 반대입니다: 온라인에서 조사하고, 직접 구매하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: 옴니채널은 쇼우루밍에 대한 방어적 답변의 일부입니다 — 고객이 당신의 통로에 서 있는 동안 휴대폰으로 가격 확인을 할 것이라면, 당신은 그들이 어떤 방식으로든 *당신에게서* 사기를 원할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상에서

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: 콜롬버스에서 목요일이고 토요일 여행을 위해 재킷이 필요합니다.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: 인스타그램 광고에서 $129에 하나를 발견했습니다.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: 클릭해서 들어가지만, 배송은 "화요일 도착"이라고 합니다 — 너무 늦습니다.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: 그러면 제품 페이지가 두 번째 옵션을 보여줍니다: **Easton Town Center에서 재고 있음 — 오늘 픽업.** 온라인으로 구매하고, 이메일로 QR 코드를 받고, 주차하고, 픽업 카운터로 걸어가고, 4분 만에 나갑니다.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: 운영상 방금 일어난 일을 보세요.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: 판매는 디지털 주문으로 기록되었지만, 제품은 가게 선반에서 나왔습니다.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: 가게 직원이 휴대용 스캐너에서 픽업 작업을 받았고, 재킷을 뽑았으며, 픽업 구역에 배치했습니다.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: 당신의 충성도 포인트는 당신이 온라인에서 사용하는 동일한 계정에 게시되었습니다.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: 맞지 않으면 어느 위치에나 반품할 수 있습니다 — 웹사이트가 즉시 다시 볼 수 있는 판매 가능한 인벤토리로 돌아갑니다.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: 그 마지막 부분이 소매업체들이 이를 그렇게 열심히 추진하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: 고객 편의만이 아닙니다; 그것은 **자산 활용**입니다.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: 대도시 지역의 가게들은 이미 고객 근처에 있는 인벤토리입니다.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: 이들을 미니 배송 센터로 사용하면 수백 마일 떨어진 하나의 배포 센터에서 모든 것을 배송하는 것보다 빠른 배송이 저렴하며, 픽업 여행은 종종 계산대에서 추가 상품으로 변하는 발길 트래픽을 생성합니다.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: 예를 들어, Target은 공개적으로 자신의 가게들이 디지털 주문의 대부분을 충족한다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: 비용도 똑같이 실제입니다.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: 가게 인력이 판매 현장에서 끌어내어 픽업과 패킹을 합니다.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: 인벤토리 정확도는 높아야 하는데, 이미 청구한 항목에 대한 취소된 주문은 고객을 잃는 가장 빠른 방법 중 하나이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: 그리고 회계가 어색해집니다: 판매는 디지털이지만 가게가 일을 했다면, 누구의 숫자인가요?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: 그 질문 — **채널 갈등** — 기술보다 더 많은 옴니채널 프로젝트를 정체시킵니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. 멀티채널은 브랜드로 여러 분리된 문을 의미하고; 옴니채널은 조직 구조가 아닌 고객의 측면에서 정의된 하나의 통합된 경험을 의미합니다.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. 세 가지 시스템 요소를 기반으로 운영됩니다: 공유된 인벤토리 가시성, 통합된 고객 프로필, 그리고 유연한 배송 논리.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. 보상은 편의성과 매장 자산의 더 나은 사용입니다; 대가는 매장 인력, 엄격한 인벤토리 정확도, 그리고 판매 신용을 두고 하는 내부 싸움입니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가진단

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** 소매업체가 웹사이트와 200개의 매장을 운영합니다.

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: 각각 별도의 인벤토리 풀을 유지하고, 웹 주문은 배포 센터에서만 배송할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: 이것은 가장 잘 다음으로 설명됩니다:

segments.src: A) Omnichannel  B) Multichannel  C) Ship-from-store  D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: A) 옴니채널  B) 멀티채널  C) 매장에서 배송  D) 무한 통로

segments.src: **2.** True or False — A customer who researches a product online and then buys it at a physical store is *showrooming*.
segments.tr: **2.** 참 또는 거짓 — 온라인에서 제품을 조사한 후 물리적 가게에서 구매하는 고객은 *쇼우루밍*입니다.

segments.src: **3.** Which is the most direct operational risk of using stores to fulfill online orders?
segments.tr: **3.** 온라인 주문을 이행하기 위해 매장을 사용하는 것의 가장 직접적인 운영상 위험은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: A) Higher advertising costs
segments.tr: A) 더 높은 광고 비용

segments.src: B) Cancelled orders caused by inaccurate store inventory counts
segments.tr: B) 부정확한 매장 인벤토리 개수로 인한 취소된 주문

segments.src: C) Fewer SKUs listed on the website
segments.tr: C) 웹사이트에 나열된 SKU 수 감소

segments.src: D) Losing loyalty program members
segments.tr: D) 충성도 프로그램 회원 상실

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **옴니채널** — 채널이 인벤토리, 고객 데이터, 그리고 배송을 공유하여 쇼퍼가 분리된 사업이 아닌 하나의 브랜드를 경험하는 운영 모델.

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **멀티채널** — 각각 자신의 인벤토리와 시스템을 가지고 독립적으로 운영되는 여러 채널을 통한 판매.

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (온라인에서 오프라인으로)** — 온라인 수요를 물리적 위치에 연결하고 돌아오는 것, 예를 들어 앱에서 구매하고 가게에서 픽업하기.

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **매장 배송 (BOPIS / 커브사이드 / 매장에서 배송)** — 고객이 수집하든 매장이 배송하든 매장 재고에서 온라인 주문을 처리하는 것.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **채널 갈등** — 채널이 동일한 고객, 마진, 또는 판매 신용을 두고 경쟁할 때 내부 마찰.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — separate inventory pools and no store fulfillment means the channels coexist but aren't integrated.
segments.tr: *답변: 1) B — 별도의 인벤토리 풀과 매장 배송이 없다는 것은 채널이 공존하지만 통합되지 않는다는 의미입니다.

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) 거짓 — 그것은 웹루밍입니다; 쇼우루밍은 가게에서 검사하고 온라인에서 구매하는 것입니다.

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B — 매장 인벤토리 개수는 배포 센터보다 일반적으로 덜 정확하므로, 실제로 없는 제품을 약속하면 고객이 이미 지불한 후에 취소로 이어집니다.*

zh.title: [零售101 #12] 你的邻近门店现在也是仓库了

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > 全渠道零售意味着客户向一个品牌购物，而不是通过四个独立的渠道——只有当库存、客户数据和履单紧密整合在幕后时，这才能行得通。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: 零售商过去按渠道进行思考。

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: 门店是一项业务，网站是另一项，目录或呼叫中心又是第三项。

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: 每个渠道都有自己的库存池、自己的定价，有时甚至有自己的损益表和主管。

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: 这就是**多渠道**零售：进入同一品牌的多个渠道，但这些渠道彼此不沟通。

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **全渠道**翻转了视角。

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: 与其问"每个渠道的表现如何？"，不如问"从客户的角度看这是什么样的？"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: 购物者从不会想*我现在在移动渠道中。*他们在手机上看到广告，在笔记本电脑上读评论，在门店中接触商品，然后以最便捷的方式购买。

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: 全渠道是使所有这些接触点像一个门店一样运作的运营模式。

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: 常见的简称是**O2O——线上到线下**，然后再返回。

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: 线上需求将客户吸引到实体地点（在应用上订购，在柜台取货），实体地点为线上需求服务（从门店库存发货，在服务台处理网络退货）。

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: 困难的部分不是店面。

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: 而是底层系统。

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: 三件事必须整合在一起：

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **库存可见性。**对库存及其位置的统一视图。如果网站看不到辛辛那提一家门店中的三件夹克，就无法销售它们。

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **客户数据。**跨渠道统一的客户资料——采购记录、忠诚度积分、退货、保存的购物车。否则门店员工不知道客户二十分钟前在线上做了什么。

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **履单逻辑。**逐订单决定由哪个节点履单的规则：配送中心、邻近门店或供应商直接发货。

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: 做好这三项，你就可以提供取货、路边取货、无限货架和无痛退货。

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: 忽视它们，"全渠道"就只是一个带有门店定位器的网站。

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: 这里有两个值得了解的行为术语。

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **展厅浏览**是指在门店检查商品，然后在线上购买，通常是从竞争对手那里。

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **网络浏览**是相反的：在线研究，然后线下购买。

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: 全渠道在某种程度上是对展厅浏览的防守回应——如果客户会在你的过道中站着用手机检查价格，你宁愿他们从*你这里*购买，以他们喜欢的任何方式。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: 今天是哥伦布市的星期四，你需要为周六的旅行买一件夹克。

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: 你在一则Instagram广告中看到一件，价格为$129。

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: 你点击进入，但运费显示"周二送达"——太晚了。

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: 然后产品页面显示第二个选项：**Easton Town Center有现货——今天取货。**你在线购买，通过电子邮件获取二维码，停车，走到取货柜台，四分钟后你就离开了。

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: 看看操作上刚刚发生了什么。

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: 销售被记为数字订单，但商品来自门店货架。

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: 门店员工在手持扫描器上收到拣货任务，取出夹克，并将其放在取货区。

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: 你的忠诚度积分记入你在线使用的同一个账户。

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: 如果不合适，你可以在任何地点退货——它会重新进入可销售库存，网站可以立即看到。

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: 最后一部分是零售商大力推动这一模式的原因。

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: 这不仅仅是客户便利；这是**资产利用**。

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: 城市地区的门店是已经靠近客户的库存。

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: 将它们用作小型履单中心，比从几百英里外的一个配送中心运送所有商品更便宜，而且取货行程会产生脚流量，通常会导致结账时多购买一件商品。

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: 例如，Target已公开报告其门店履单了绝大多数数字订单。

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: 成本同样真实。

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: 门店劳动力被从销售楼层拉出来进行拣货和包装。

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: 库存准确度必须很高，因为取消已经收费的商品订单是失去客户的最快方式之一。

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: 会计问题也变得尴尬：如果销售是数字的，但门店做了工作，那么这是谁的数据？

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: 这个问题——**渠道冲突**——使比技术问题更多的全渠道项目停滞不前。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. 多渠道意味着进入品牌的多个独立渠道；全渠道意味着一个集成体验，从客户的角度而不是组织结构图定义。

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. 它运行在三个底层系统上：共享库存可见性、统一的客户资料和灵活的履单逻辑。

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. 回报是便利加上更好地利用门店资产；代价是门店劳动力、严格的库存准确度和关于销售信用的内部纠纷。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** 一个零售商运营一个网站和200家门店。

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: 每个渠道都有独立的库存池，网络订单只能从配送中心发货。

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: 这最好被描述为：

segments.src: A) Omnichannel  B) Multichannel  C) Ship-from-store  D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: A) 全渠道  B) 多渠道  C) 门店发货  D) 无限货架

segments.src: **2.** True or False — A customer who researches a product online and then buys it at a physical store is *showrooming*.
segments.tr: **2.** 正确或错误——在线研究产品然后在实体门店购买的客户是*展厅浏览*。

segments.src: **3.** Which is the most direct operational risk of using stores to fulfill online orders?
segments.tr: **3.** 使用门店履单线上订单的最直接的运营风险是什么？

segments.src: A) Higher advertising costs
segments.tr: A) 更高的广告成本

segments.src: B) Cancelled orders caused by inaccurate store inventory counts
segments.tr: B) 由于不准确的门店库存计数导致的订单取消

segments.src: C) Fewer SKUs listed on the website
segments.tr: C) 网站上列出的SKU更少

segments.src: D) Losing loyalty program members
segments.tr: D) 失去忠诚度计划成员

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **全渠道** — 一种渠道共享库存、客户数据和履单的运营模式，使购物者体验到一个品牌而不是独立的业务。

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **多渠道** — 通过独立运营的多个渠道销售，每个渠道都有自己的库存和系统。

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O（线上到线下）** — 连接线上需求和实体地点的往返，例如在应用上购买和在门店取货。

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **门店履单（BOPIS / 路边取货 / 门店发货）** — 用门店库存履单线上订单，无论是客户上门取货还是门店发货。

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **渠道冲突** — 当渠道在相同客户、利润或销售信用上竞争时产生的内部摩擦。

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — separate inventory pools and no store fulfillment means the channels coexist but aren't integrated.
segments.tr: *答案：1) B——独立的库存池和没有门店履单意味着渠道共存但未整合。

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) 错误——那是网络浏览；展厅浏览是在门店检查和在线购买。

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B——门店库存计数通常不如配送中心准确，所以许诺实际上不存在的商品会导致客户已付款后的订单取消。*

hi.title: [Retailing 101 #12] आपकी पड़ोस की दुकान अब एक गोदाम भी है

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > ऑमनीचैनल रीटेल का मतलब है कि ग्राहक एक ब्रांड से खरीदारी करता है, चार अलग-अलग चैनलों की बजाय — जो केवल तभी काम करता है जब इन्वेंटरी, ग्राहक डेटा, और पूर्ति पर्दे के पीछे एक साथ जुड़ी हों।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: खुदरा विक्रेता चैनलों में सोचा करते थे।

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: दुकानें एक व्यवसाय थीं, वेबसाइट दूसरी, कैटलॉग या कॉल सेंटर तीसरी।

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक के पास अपना इन्वेंटरी पूल था, अपनी मूल्य निर्धारण, कभी-कभी अपना P&L और अपना प्रबंधक।

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: यह **मल्टीचैनल** रीटेल है: एक ही ब्रांड में कई द्वार, लेकिन द्वार एक-दूसरे से बात नहीं करते।

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **ऑमनीचैनल** दृष्टिकोण को उलट देता है।

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: "प्रत्येक चैनल ने कैसा प्रदर्शन किया?" पूछने की जगह, यह पूछता है "ग्राहक की जगह से यह कैसा दिखता है?"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: एक खरीदार कभी नहीं सोचता *मैं अभी मोबाइल चैनल में हूँ।* वे फोन पर विज्ञापन देखते हैं, लैपटॉप पर समीक्षाएं पढ़ते हैं, दुकान में वस्तु को छूते हैं, और जो भी तरीका उस पल सबसे आसान हो वही खरीद करते हैं।

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: ऑमनीचैनल वह परिचालन मॉडल है जो सभी टचपॉइंट्स को एक दुकान की तरह व्यवहार करता है।

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: आम संक्षिप्त नाम है **O2O — ऑनलाइन टू ऑफलाइन**, और वापस।

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: ऑनलाइन मांग लोगों को भौतिक स्थानों में खींचती है (ऐप पर ऑर्डर करें, काउंटर पर उठाएं), और भौतिक स्थान ऑनलाइन मांग की सेवा करते हैं (दुकान के स्टॉक से ऑर्डर भेजें, सेवा डेस्क पर वेब रिटर्न लें)।

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: कठिन हिस्सा स्टोरफ्रंट नहीं है।

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: यह प्लंबिंग है।

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: तीन चीजों को एकीकृत होना चाहिए:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **इन्वेंटरी दृश्यता।** यह जानने का एक साझा दृश्य कि क्या हाथ में है और कहां। अगर वेबसाइट Cincinnati में एक दुकान की शेल्फ पर तीन जैकेटों को नहीं देख सकती, तो वह उन्हें नहीं बेच सकती।

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **ग्राहक डेटा।** चैनलों के पार एक प्रोफाइल — खरीद, वफादारी अंक, रिटर्न, सहेजी गई कार्ट। अन्यथा फर्श पर कर्मचारी को पता नहीं है कि ग्राहक ने बीस मिनट पहले ऑनलाइन क्या किया।

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **पूर्ति तर्क।** नियम जो तय करते हैं, ऑर्डर दर ऑर्डर, कौन सी नोड इसे सेवा देती है: एक वितरण केंद्र, एक पास की दुकान, या विक्रेता सीधे भेजना।

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: इन तीनों को सही करें और आप पिकअप, कर्बसाइड, अंतहीन गलियारा, और सुखद रिटर्न प्रदान कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: इन्हें छोड़ें और "ऑमनीचैनल" बस एक वेबसाइट है जिस पर स्टोर लोकेटर है।

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: यहां जानने के लिए दो व्यवहार संबंधी शब्द हैं।

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **शोरूमिंग** दुकान में किसी वस्तु का निरीक्षण करना और फिर इसे ऑनलाइन खरीदना है, अक्सर किसी प्रतिद्वंद्वी से।

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **वेब्रूमिंग** विपरीत है: ऑनलाइन शोध करना, फिर व्यक्तिगत रूप से खरीदना।

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: ऑमनीचैनल शोरूमिंग का आंशिक रक्षात्मक उत्तर है — अगर कोई ग्राहक आपकी गली में खड़े होकर अपने फोन पर कीमत जांचने वाला है, तो आप चाहेंगे कि वह *आपसे* खरीदे, जिस भी तरीके से वह पसंद करता है।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की जिंदगी में

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: यह Columbus में गुरुवार है और आपको शनिवार की यात्रा के लिए एक जैकेट चाहिए।

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: आप Instagram विज्ञापन पर $129 में एक देखते हैं।

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: आप टैप करते हैं, लेकिन डिलीवरी "मंगलवार को आता है" कहता है — बहुत देर हो गई।

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: फिर उत्पाद पृष्ठ एक दूसरा विकल्प दिखाता है: **Easton Town Center में स्टॉक में — आज उठाएं।** आप इसे ऑनलाइन खरीदते हैं, ईमेल द्वारा QR कोड प्राप्त करते हैं, पार्क करते हैं, पिकअप काउंटर तक चलते हैं, और आप चार मिनट में निकल जाते हैं।

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: देखें कि परिचालन दृष्टि से क्या हुआ।

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: बिक्री एक डिजिटल ऑर्डर के रूप में दर्ज की गई थी, लेकिन इकाई दुकान की शेल्फ से आई थी।

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: एक दुकान कर्मचारी को हैंडहेल्ड स्कैनर पर पिक कार्य मिला, जैकेट निकाली, और इसे पिकअप क्षेत्र में रखा।

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: आपके वफादारी अंक उसी खाते में दर्ज किए गए जो आप ऑनलाइन उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: और अगर यह फिट नहीं है, तो आप किसी भी स्थान पर इसे लौटा सकते हैं — जहां यह बिक्री योग्य इन्वेंटरी में वापस जाता है जो वेबसाइट तुरंत फिर से देख सकती है।

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: वह अंतिम भाग यही है कि खुदरा विक्रेता इस पर इतना जोर क्यों देते हैं।

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: यह केवल ग्राहक सुविधा नहीं है; यह **परिसंपत्ति उपयोग** है।

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: शहरी क्षेत्रों में दुकानें ऐसी इन्वेंटरी हैं जो पहले से ही ग्राहक के पास बैठती हैं।

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: उन्हें मिनी-पूर्ति केंद्र के रूप में उपयोग करने से तेजी से डिलीवरी सस्ती हो जाती है बनाम सबकुछ एक वितरण केंद्र से सैकड़ों मील दूर से भेजना, और पिकअप यात्राएं पैदल यातायात बढ़ाती हैं जो अक्सर चेकआउट पर एक अतिरिक्त वस्तु में बदल जाता है।

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: उदाहरण के लिए, Target ने सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट किया है कि इसकी दुकानें इसके अधिकांश डिजिटल ऑर्डर पूरे करती हैं।

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: लागतें उतनी ही वास्तविक हैं।

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: दुकान का श्रम बिक्री फर्श से पिकिंग और पैकिंग में खींचा जाता है।

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: इन्वेंटरी सटीकता अधिक होनी चाहिए, क्योंकि कुछ के लिए रद्द किया गया ऑर्डर जो आपने पहले से ही चार्ज किया है, ग्राहक को खोने का सबसे तेजी से तरीका है।

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: और लेखांकन अजीब हो जाता है: अगर बिक्री डिजिटल थी लेकिन दुकान ने काम किया, तो यह किसका नंबर है?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: वह सवाल — **चैनल संघर्ष** — अधिकांश ऑमनीचैनल परियोजनाओं को अवरुद्ध करता है, तकनीक कभी नहीं।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## तीन-पंक्ति सारांश

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. मल्टीचैनल का मतलब है एक ब्रांड में कई अलग द्वार; ऑमनीचैनल का मतलब है एक एकीकृत अनुभव, संगठन चार्ट की बजाय ग्राहक के दृष्टिकोण से परिभाषित।

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. यह तीन चीजों पर चलता है: साझा इन्वेंटरी दृश्यता, एक एकीकृत ग्राहक प्रोफाइल, और लचीली पूर्ति तर्क।

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. लाभ सुविधा है साथ ही दुकान परिसंपत्तियों का बेहतर उपयोग; कीमत है दुकान का श्रम, कठोर इन्वेंटरी सटीकता, और बिक्री क्रेडिट पर आंतरिक लड़ाई।

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ आत्म-परीक्षा

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** एक खुदरा विक्रेता एक वेबसाइट और 200 दुकानें चलाता है।

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक एक अलग इन्वेंटरी पूल रखता है, और वेब ऑर्डर केवल वितरण केंद्र से भेजे जा सकते हैं।

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: इसे सर्वोत्तम रूप से वर्णित किया जा सकता है:

segments.src: A) Omnichannel  B) Multichannel  C) Ship-from-store  D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: A) ऑमनीचैनल  B) मल्टीचैनल  C) दुकान से भेजें  D) अंतहीन गलियारा

segments.src: **2.** True or False — A customer who researches a product online and then buys it at a physical store is *showrooming*.
segments.tr: **2.** सत्य या असत्य — एक ग्राहक जो किसी उत्पाद का ऑनलाइन शोध करता है और फिर इसे भौतिक दुकान में खरीदता है *शोरूमिंग* है।

segments.src: **3.** Which is the most direct operational risk of using stores to fulfill online orders?
segments.tr: **3.** ऑनलाइन ऑर्डर पूरा करने के लिए दुकानों का उपयोग करने का सबसे प्रत्यक्ष परिचालन जोखिम क्या है?

segments.src: A) Higher advertising costs
segments.tr: A) उच्च विज्ञापन लागत

segments.src: B) Cancelled orders caused by inaccurate store inventory counts
segments.tr: B) अशुद्ध दुकान इन्वेंटरी गणना के कारण रद्द किए गए ऑर्डर

segments.src: C) Fewer SKUs listed on the website
segments.tr: C) वेबसाइट पर सूचीबद्ध कम SKUs

segments.src: D) Losing loyalty program members
segments.tr: D) वफादारी कार्यक्रम सदस्यों को खोना

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शर्तें

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **ऑमनीचैनल** — एक परिचालन मॉडल जहां चैनल इन्वेंटरी, ग्राहक डेटा, और पूर्ति साझा करते हैं ताकि खरीदार अलग-अलग व्यवसायों की बजाय एक ब्रांड का अनुभव करे।

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **मल्टीचैनल** — कई चैनलों के माध्यम से बिक्री जो स्वतंत्र रूप से चलते हैं, प्रत्येक के अपने इन्वेंटरी और सिस्टम के साथ।

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (ऑनलाइन टू ऑफलाइन)** — ऑनलाइन मांग को भौतिक स्थानों से जोड़ना और वापस, जैसे ऐप पर खरीदना और दुकान पर उठाना।

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **दुकान पूर्ति (BOPIS / कर्बसाइड / दुकान से भेजें)** — ऑनलाइन ऑर्डर को दुकान के स्टॉक से पूरा करना, चाहे ग्राहक इसे एकत्र करे या दुकान इसे भेजे।

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **चैनल संघर्ष** — आंतरिक घर्षण जब चैनल एक ही ग्राहक, मार्जिन, या बिक्री के लिए क्रेडिट के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — separate inventory pools and no store fulfillment means the channels coexist but aren't integrated.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: 1) B — अलग इन्वेंटरी पूल और कोई दुकान पूर्ति नहीं मतलब चैनल सहअस्तित्व में हैं लेकिन एकीकृत नहीं हैं।

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) असत्य — यह वेब्रूमिंग है; शोरूमिंग दुकान में निरीक्षण करना और ऑनलाइन खरीदना है।

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B — दुकान इन्वेंटरी गणना आमतौर पर वितरण केंद्र की तुलना में कम सटीक है, इसलिए एक इकाई का वादा करना जो वास्तव में वहां नहीं है ग्राहक पहले से ही भुगतान करने के बाद रद्द करने की ओर जाता है।*

es.title: [Retailing 101 #12] Tu Tienda de Barrio Ahora También es un Almacén

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > El comercio minorista omnicanal significa que el cliente compra una marca en lugar de cuatro canales separados — lo cual solo funciona si el inventario, los datos del cliente y el cumplimiento están conectados detrás de las escenas.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## El Concepto de Hoy

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: Los minoristas solían pensar en términos de canales.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: Las tiendas eran un negocio, el sitio web otro, el catálogo o centro de llamadas un tercero.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: Cada uno tenía su propio inventario, su propio precio, a veces su propio P&L y su propio jefe.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: Eso es comercio minorista **multicanal**: varias puertas hacia la misma marca, pero las puertas no se comunican entre sí.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **Omnicanal** invierte el punto de vista.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: En lugar de preguntar "¿cómo se desempeñó cada canal?", pregunta "¿cómo se ve esto desde donde está el cliente?".

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: Un comprador nunca piensa *estoy en el canal móvil ahora*. Ve un anuncio en un teléfono, lee comentarios en una computadora portátil, toca el artículo en una tienda y compra de la manera que le resulte más fácil en ese momento.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: Omnicanal es el modelo operativo que hace que todos esos puntos de contacto se comporten como una sola tienda.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: La abreviatura común es **O2O — en línea a fuera de línea**, y viceversa.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: La demanda en línea atrae a las personas a ubicaciones físicas (pedir en la aplicación, recoger en el mostrador), y las ubicaciones físicas sirven a la demanda en línea (enviar un pedido del inventario de la tienda, aceptar una devolución web en el mostrador de servicio).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: La parte difícil no es la tienda online.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: Es la infraestructura.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: Tres cosas deben estar integradas:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **Visibilidad del inventario.** Una vista compartida de lo que hay disponible y dónde. Si el sitio web no puede ver las tres chaquetas en una tienda en Cincinnati, no puede venderlas.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **Datos del cliente.** Un perfil en todos los canales — compras, puntos de lealtad, devoluciones, carritos guardados. De lo contrario, el vendedor en el piso no sabe qué hizo el cliente en línea hace veinte minutos.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **Lógica de cumplimiento.** Reglas que deciden, pedido por pedido, qué nodo lo atiende: un centro de distribución, una tienda cercana o un proveedor que envía directamente.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: Si aciertas con esos tres, puedes ofrecer recogida, recogida en la acera, pasillo infinito y devoluciones sin problemas.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: Si los saltas, "omnicanal" es solo un sitio web con un localizador de tiendas.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: Dos términos de comportamiento vale la pena conocer aquí.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **Showrooming** es inspeccionar un artículo en una tienda y luego comprarlo en línea, a menudo de un competidor.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **Webrooming** es lo opuesto: investigar en línea y luego comprar en persona.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: Omnicanal es en parte una respuesta defensiva al showrooming — si un cliente va a verificar el precio en su teléfono mientras está en tu pasillo, preferirías que compre *de ti*, de la manera que prefiera.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: Es jueves en Columbus y necesitas una chaqueta para un viaje el sábado.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: Ves una en un anuncio de Instagram por $129.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: Tocas, pero dice que el envío "llega el martes" — demasiado tarde.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: Luego, la página del producto muestra una segunda opción: **En stock en Easton Town Center — recoge hoy.** Compra en línea, obtiene un código QR por correo electrónico, estaciona, camina hasta el mostrador de recogida y te vas en cuatro minutos.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: Mira lo que acaba de suceder operacionalmente.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: La venta se registró como un pedido digital, pero la unidad salió de un estante de tienda.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: Un empleado de la tienda recibió una tarea de recogida en un escáner portátil, sacó la chaqueta y la colocó en el área de recogida.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: Tus puntos de lealtad se acreditaron en la misma cuenta que usas en línea.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: Y si no te queda bien, puedes devolverla en cualquier ubicación — donde vuelve al inventario vendible que el sitio web puede ver inmediatamente de nuevo.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: Esa última parte es por qué los minoristas impulsan esto tan fuerte.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: No es solo conveniencia del cliente; es **utilización de activos**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: Las tiendas en áreas metropolitanas son inventario que ya está cerca del cliente.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: Usarlas como mini centros de cumplimiento hace que la entrega rápida sea más barata que enviar todo desde un centro de distribución a cientos de kilómetros de distancia, y los viajes de recogida generan tráfico peatonal que a menudo se convierte en un artículo adicional en el pago.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: Target, por ejemplo, ha informado públicamente que sus tiendas cumplen la gran mayoría de sus pedidos digitales.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: Los costos son igual de reales.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: La mano de obra de la tienda se extrae del piso de ventas para recoger y empacar.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: La precisión del inventario debe ser alta, porque un pedido cancelado de algo que ya cobraste es una de las formas más rápidas de perder un cliente.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: Y la contabilidad se vuelve incómoda: si la venta fue digital pero la tienda hizo el trabajo, ¿de quién es el número?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: Esa pregunta — **conflicto de canales** — paraliza más proyectos omnicanal que la tecnología jamás lo hace.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen de Tres Líneas

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. Multicanal significa varias puertas separadas hacia una marca; omnicanal significa una experiencia integrada, definida desde el lado del cliente en lugar del organigrama.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. Se ejecuta sobre tres piezas de infraestructura: visibilidad compartida del inventario, un perfil de cliente unificado y lógica de cumplimiento flexible.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. La recompensa es conveniencia más mejor uso de activos de tienda; el precio es mano de obra de tienda, precisión estricta del inventario y peleas internas sobre el crédito de ventas.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de Hoy

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **Omnicanal** — Un modelo operativo donde los canales comparten inventario, datos del cliente y cumplimiento para que el comprador experimente una marca en lugar de negocios separados.

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **Multicanal** — Venta a través de varios canales que funcionan independientemente, cada uno con su propio inventario y sistemas.

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (En línea a Fuera de línea)** — Conectar la demanda en línea a ubicaciones físicas y viceversa, como comprar en una aplicación y recoger en una tienda.

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **Cumplimiento de tienda (BOPIS / recogida en la acera / envío desde tienda)** — Servir un pedido en línea del inventario de la tienda, ya sea que el cliente lo recoja o la tienda lo envíe.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.

ar.title: [البيع بالتجزئة 101 #12] متجرك المحلي هو أيضاً مستودع الآن

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة يعني أن العميل يتسوق من علامة تجارية واحدة بدلاً من أربع قنوات منفصلة — وهذا لا يعمل إلا إذا كانت المخزون وبيانات العملاء والتنفيذ متصلة معاً خلف الكواليس.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## المفهوم اليومي

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: اعتادت تجار التجزئة على التفكير بالقنوات.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: المتاجر كانت عملاً واحداً، والموقع الإلكتروني عملاً آخر، والكتالوج أو مركز الاتصال ثالثاً.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: لكل منها مجموعة مخزونها الخاصة وتسعيرتها الخاصة وأحياناً بيان الدخل والخسارة الخاص بها ورئيسها الخاص.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: هذا هو البيع بالتجزئة **متعدد القنوات**: عدة أبواب إلى نفس العلامة التجارية، لكن الأبواب لا تتحدث مع بعضها البعض.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة** يقلب وجهة النظر.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: بدلاً من السؤال "كيف أداء كل قناة؟"، يسأل "كيف يبدو هذا من حيث يقف العميل؟"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: المتسوق لا يفكر أبداً *أنا في القناة المحمولة الآن.* يرى إعلاناً على الهاتف، يقرأ التقييمات على جهاز كمبيوتر محمول، يلمس المنتج في متجر، ويشتري بأي طريقة تكون أسهل في تلك اللحظة.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة هو نموذج التشغيل الذي يجعل جميع نقاط الاتصال تتصرف كمتجر واحد.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: الاختصار الشائع هو **O2O — من الإنترنت إلى الواقع**، وبالعكس.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: الطلب عبر الإنترنت يجذب الناس إلى المواقع الفيزيائية (اطلب عبر التطبيق، استلم من الكاونتر)، والمواقع الفيزيائية تخدم الطلب عبر الإنترنت (شحن طلب من مخزون المتجر، استقبال إرجاع ويب في مكتب الخدمة).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: الجزء الصعب ليس واجهة المتجر.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: إنه البنية التحتية.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: ثلاثة أشياء يجب أن تكون متكاملة:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **رؤية المخزون.** عرض واحد مشترك لما هو في متناول اليد وأين. إذا لم يتمكن الموقع الإلكتروني من رؤية الثلاث سترات الجالسة في متجر في سينسيناتي، فلا يمكنه بيعها.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **بيانات العميل.** ملف تعريف واحد عبر القنوات — المشتريات والنقاط والإرجاعات والعربات المحفوظة. وإلا فإن الموظف على الأرضية لن تكون لديه أي فكرة عما فعله العميل عبر الإنترنت قبل عشرين دقيقة.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **منطق التنفيذ.** قواعد تقرر، طلباً تلو الآخر، أي عقدة تخدمه: مركز توزيع أو متجر قريب أو بائع يشحن مباشرة.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: احصل على تلك الثلاثة بشكل صحيح وستتمكن من تقديم الاستلام والاستقبال من جانب الطريق والرفوف اللامحدودة والإرجاعات البسيطة.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: تخطيهم و"البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة" ليس سوى موقع ويب بمحدد موقع متجر عليه.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: هناك مصطلحا سلوك يستحقان المعرفة هنا.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **عرض المتجر والشراء من الإنترنت** هو فحص منتج في متجر ثم شراؤه عبر الإنترنت، غالباً من منافس.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **البحث عبر الويب والشراء من المتجر** هو العكس: البحث عبر الإنترنت ثم الشراء شخصياً.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة هو جزئياً إجابة دفاعية على عرض المتجر والشراء من الإنترنت — إذا كان العميل سيتحقق من السعر على هاتفه بينما يقف في الممر الخاص بك، فستفضل أن يشتروا منك *أنت*، بأي طريقة يفضلونها.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: إنه يوم الخميس في كولومبوس وتحتاج إلى سترة لرحلة في يوم السبت.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: تلاحظ واحدة في إعلان Instagram مقابل $129.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: تصل إلى الموقع، لكن الشحن يقول "يصل يوم الثلاثاء" — متأخر جداً.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: ثم تعرض صفحة المنتج خياراً ثانياً: **متوفر في Easton Town Center — استلم اليوم.** تشتريه عبر الإنترنت وتحصل على رمز QR عبر البريد الإلكتروني وتتوقف وتمشي إلى كاونتر الاستلام وتخرج في أربع دقائق.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: انظر إلى ما حدث للتو من الناحية التشغيلية.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: تم تسجيل البيع كطلب رقمي، لكن الوحدة أتت من رف المتجر.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: حصل موظف المتجر على مهمة اختيار على ماسح يدوي، وسحب السترة، ونظمها في منطقة الاستلام.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: تم نشر نقاط ولائك في نفس الحساب الذي تستخدمه عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: وإذا لم تناسبك، يمكنك إعادتها في أي موقع — حيث تعود إلى المخزون القابل للبيع الذي يمكن للموقع الإلكتروني رؤيته مرة أخرى على الفور.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: هذا الجزء الأخير هو السبب في أن تجار التجزئة يدفعون هذا بقوة.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: إنه ليس فقط سهولة العميل؛ إنه **استخدام الأصول**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: المتاجر في المناطق الحضرية هي مخزون يجلس بالفعل بالقرب من العميل.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: استخدامها كمراكز تنفيذ صغيرة يجعل التسليم السريع أرخص من شحن كل شيء من مركز توزيع واحد على بعد مئات الأميال، وتوليد حركة المشاة من رحلات الاستلام التي غالباً ما تتحول إلى عنصر إضافي عند الدفع.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: Target، على سبيل المثال، أبلغت علناً أن متاجرها تنفذ الغالبية العظمى من طلباتها الرقمية.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: التكاليف حقيقية تماماً.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: يتم سحب عمل المتجر من الأرضية البيعية لالتقاط الحزم.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: يجب أن تكون دقة المخزون عالية، لأن الطلب الملغى على شيء تم شحنه بالفعل هو أحد أسرع الطرق لفقدان عميل.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: والمحاسبة تصبح محرجة: إذا كان البيع رقمياً لكن المتجر قام بالعمل، فلمن هو الرقم؟

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: هذا السؤال — **الصراع بين القنوات** — يعطل مشاريع البيع بالقنوات المتعددة المتكاملة أكثر من التكنولوجيا.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## إعادة صياغة ثلاث أسطر

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. يعمل على ثلاث قطع من البنية التحتية: رؤية المخزون المشتركة وملف تعريف عميل موحد ومنطق تنفيذ مرن.

fr.title: [Retailing 101 #12] Votre magasin de quartier est aussi un entrepôt maintenant

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > La vente au détail omnicanal signifie que le client achète une seule marque au lieu de quatre canaux distincts — ce qui ne fonctionne que si l'inventaire, les données client et l'exécution des commandes sont intégrés en arrière-plan.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: Les détaillants avaient l'habitude de penser en termes de canaux.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: Les magasins étaient une entreprise, le site Web une autre, le catalogue ou le centre d'appels une troisième.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: Chacun avait son propre stock, sa propre tarification, parfois son propre compte de résultat et son propre patron.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: C'est la vente au détail **multicanal** : plusieurs portes vers la même marque, mais les portes ne communiquent pas entre elles.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: L'**omnicanal** change de point de vue.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: Au lieu de demander « comment chaque canal a-t-il performé ? », il demande « à quoi cela ressemble-t-il du point de vue du client ? »

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: Un acheteur ne pense jamais *Je suis dans le canal mobile maintenant.* Il voit une annonce sur un téléphone, lit les avis sur un ordinateur portable, touche l'article en magasin et achète de la manière la plus facile à ce moment-là.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: L'omnicanal est le modèle opérationnel qui fait que tous ces points de contact se comportent comme un seul magasin.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: L'abréviation courante est **O2O — en ligne vers hors ligne**, et vice-versa.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: La demande en ligne attire les gens dans les lieux physiques (commander sur l'application, récupérer au comptoir), et les lieux physiques servent la demande en ligne (expédier une commande à partir du stock du magasin, accepter un retour Web au service après-vente).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: La partie difficile n'est pas la vitrine.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: C'est la plomberie.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: Trois choses doivent être intégrées :

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **Visibilité de l'inventaire.** Une vue partagée de ce qui est disponible et où. Si le site Web ne peut pas voir les trois vestes qui se trouvent dans un magasin à Cincinnati, il ne peut pas les vendre.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **Données client.** Un profil unique sur tous les canaux — achats, points de fidélité, retours, paniers enregistrés. Sinon, l'associé en magasin ne sait pas ce que le client a fait en ligne il y a vingt minutes.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **Logique d'exécution.** Des règles qui décident, commande par commande, quel nœud l'exécute : un centre de distribution, un magasin à proximité ou un fournisseur qui expédie directement.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: Si vous faites correctement ces trois choses, vous pouvez proposer le retrait, le service au trottoir, l'allée sans fin et les retours sans friction.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: Ignorez-les et « omnicanal » n'est qu'un site Web avec un localisateur de magasin.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: Deux termes de comportement méritent d'être connus ici.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: Le **showrooming** consiste à inspecter un article en magasin, puis à l'acheter en ligne, souvent auprès d'un concurrent.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: Le **webrooming** est l'inverse : faire des recherches en ligne, puis acheter en personne.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: L'omnicanal est en partie une réponse défensive au showrooming — si un client va vérifier les prix sur son téléphone en se tenant dans votre allée, vous préférez qu'il achète *chez vous*, de la manière qu'il préfère.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: C'est jeudi à Columbus et vous avez besoin d'une veste pour un voyage samedi.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: Vous en repérez une dans une annonce Instagram pour $129.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: Vous appuyez, mais l'expédition dit « arrive mardi » — trop tard.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: Ensuite, la page du produit affiche une deuxième option : **En stock à Easton Town Center — retrait aujourd'hui.** Vous l'achetez en ligne, recevez un code QR par email, vous vous garez, vous vous rendez au comptoir de retrait et vous êtes parti en quatre minutes.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: Regardez ce qui vient de se passer sur le plan opérationnel.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: La vente a été enregistrée en tant que commande numérique, mais l'unité provenait d'une étagère de magasin.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: Un employé du magasin a reçu une tâche de sélection sur un scanner portable, a retiré la veste et l'a placée dans la zone de retrait.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: Vos points de fidélité ont été crédités au même compte que celui que vous utilisez en ligne.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: Et si elle ne vous va pas, vous pouvez la déposer n'importe où — où elle revient dans l'inventaire vendable que le site Web peut immédiatement voir à nouveau.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: C'est cette dernière partie qui fait que les détaillants poussent si fort.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas seulement pour la commodité du client ; c'est **l'utilisation des actifs**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: Les magasins dans les zones métropolitaines sont un inventaire qui se trouve déjà près du client.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: Les utiliser comme mini-centres d'exécution rend la livraison rapide moins chère que d'expédier tout à partir d'un seul centre de distribution à des centaines de kilomètres, et les trajets de retrait génèrent du trafic piétonnier qui se transforme souvent en un article supplémentaire à la caisse.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: Target, par exemple, a rapporté publiquement que ses magasins exécutent la grande majorité de ses commandes numériques.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: Les coûts sont tout aussi réels.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: La main-d'œuvre du magasin est retirée du plancher de vente pour sélectionner et emballer.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: La précision de l'inventaire doit être élevée, car une commande annulée sur quelque chose pour lequel vous avez déjà facturé est l'un des moyens les plus rapides de perdre un client.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: Et la comptabilité devient maladroite : si la vente était numérique mais que le magasin a fait le travail, à qui appartient ce chiffre ?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: Cette question — **conflit de canaux** — paralyse plus de projets omnicanaux que la technologie ne l'a jamais fait.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Résumé en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. Multicanal signifie plusieurs portes séparées vers une marque ; omnicanal signifie une expérience intégrée, définie du point de vue du client plutôt que de celui de l'organigramme.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. Il fonctionne sur trois éléments : la visibilité partagée de l'inventaire, un profil client unifié et une logique d'exécution flexible.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. Le bénéfice est la commodité plus une meilleure utilisation des actifs du magasin ; le prix est la main-d'œuvre du magasin, la précision stricte de l'inventaire et les combats internes pour le crédit de vente.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-évaluation

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** Un détaillant gère un site Web et 200 magasins.

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: Chacun conserve un stock séparé, et les commandes Web ne peuvent être expédiées que depuis le centre de distribution.

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: Ceci est mieux décrit comme :

segments.src: A) Omnichannel  B) Multichannel  C) Ship-from-store  D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: A) Omnicanal  B) Multicanal  C) Expédition depuis le magasin  D) Allée sans fin

segments.src: **2.** True or False — A customer who researches a product online and then buys it at a physical store is *showrooming*.
segments.tr: **2.** Vrai ou faux — Un client qui fait des recherches sur un produit en ligne puis l'achète dans un magasin physique est du *showrooming*.

segments.src: **3.** Which is the most direct operational risk of using stores to fulfill online orders?
segments.tr: **3.** Quel est le risque opérationnel le plus direct de l'utilisation de magasins pour exécuter les commandes en ligne ?

segments.src: A) Higher advertising costs
segments.tr: A) Coûts publicitaires plus élevés

segments.src: B) Cancelled orders caused by inaccurate store inventory counts
segments.tr: B) Commandes annulées causées par des comptages d'inventaire de magasin inexacts

segments.src: C) Fewer SKUs listed on the website
segments.tr: C) Moins de SKU listés sur le site Web

segments.src: D) Losing loyalty program members
segments.tr: D) Perte de membres du programme de fidélité

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Les termes d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **Omnicanal** — Un modèle opérationnel où les canaux partagent l'inventaire, les données client et l'exécution, de sorte que l'acheteur expérimente une seule marque au lieu de commerces séparés.

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **Multicanal** — Vente via plusieurs canaux qui fonctionnent indépendamment, chacun avec son propre inventaire et ses propres systèmes.

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (En ligne vers hors ligne)** — Connecter la demande en ligne aux lieux physiques et vice-versa, comme acheter sur une application et récupérer dans un magasin.

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **Exécution en magasin (BOPIS / au trottoir / expédition depuis le magasin)** — Servir une commande en ligne à partir du stock du magasin, que le client la récupère ou que le magasin l'expédie.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **Conflit de canaux** — Friction interne quand les canaux rivalisent pour le même client, la même marge ou le crédit d'une vente.

segments.tr: *Réponses : 1) B — les stocks séparés et l'absence d'exécution en magasin signifient que les canaux coexistent mais ne sont pas intégrés.

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) Faux — c'est du webrooming ; le showrooming consiste à inspecter en magasin et à acheter en ligne.

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B — les comptages d'inventaire en magasin sont généralement moins précis que ceux d'un centre de distribution, de sorte que promettre une unité qui n'existe pas vraiment entraîne des annulations après que le client a déjà payé.*
