in.title: [Retailing 101 #12] Toko Tetangga Anda Juga Sekarang Menjadi Gudang

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > Ritel omnichannel berarti pelanggan berbelanja satu merek alih-alih empat saluran terpisah — yang hanya berhasil jika inventaris, data pelanggan, dan pemenuhan pesanan dijahit bersama di balik layar.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: Pengecer biasanya berpikir dalam saluran.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: Toko adalah satu bisnis, situs web adalah yang lain, katalog atau pusat panggilan adalah yang ketiga.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: Masing-masing memiliki kumpulan inventaris sendiri, harga sendiri, kadang-kadang P&L sendiri dan bosnya sendiri.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: Itu adalah ritel **multichannel**: beberapa pintu ke merek yang sama, tetapi pintu-pintu itu tidak berbicara satu sama lain.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **Omnichannel** membalikkan sudut pandang.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: Alih-alih bertanya "bagaimana kinerja setiap saluran?", ia bertanya "bagaimana tampilannya dari mana pelanggan berdiri?"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: Seorang pembeli tidak pernah berpikir *Saya berada di saluran seluler sekarang.* Mereka melihat iklan di ponsel, membaca ulasan di laptop, menyentuh item di toko, dan membeli dengan cara yang paling mudah saat itu.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: Omnichannel adalah model operasi yang membuat semua titik sentuh itu berperilaku seperti satu toko.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: Singkatan umum adalah **O2O — online ke offline**, dan kembali lagi.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: Permintaan online menarik orang ke lokasi fisik (pesan di aplikasi, ambil di konter), dan lokasi fisik melayani permintaan online (kirim pesanan dari persediaan toko, terima pengembalian web di meja layanan).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: Bagian yang sulit bukan toko depan.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: Ini adalah sistem perpipaan.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: Tiga hal harus diintegrasikan:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **Visibilitas inventaris.** Satu tampilan bersama tentang apa yang tersedia dan di mana. Jika situs web tidak dapat melihat tiga jaket yang duduk di toko di Cincinnati, ia tidak dapat menjualnya.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **Data pelanggan.** Satu profil di semua saluran — pembelian, poin loyalitas, pengembalian, keranjang yang disimpan. Jika tidak, asosiasi di lantai tidak memiliki ide apa yang dilakukan pelanggan secara online dua puluh menit yang lalu.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **Logika pemenuhan.** Aturan yang memutuskan, pesanan demi pesanan, node mana yang melayaninya: pusat distribusi, toko terdekat, atau vendor yang mengirim langsung.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: Dapatkan tiga hal itu dengan benar dan Anda dapat menawarkan pengambilan, tepi jalan, lorong tanpa akhir, dan pengembalian tanpa rasa sakit.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: Lewati mereka dan "omnichannel" hanya sebuah situs web dengan pencari toko di atasnya.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: Dua istilah perilaku layak diketahui di sini.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **Showrooming** adalah memeriksa item di toko dan kemudian membelinya secara online, sering kali dari pesaing.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **Webrooming** adalah kebalikannya: meneliti secara online, lalu membeli secara langsung.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: Omnichannel adalah jawaban defensif sebagian untuk showrooming — jika pelanggan akan memeriksa harga di ponsel mereka sambil berdiri di lorong Anda, Anda lebih suka mereka membeli dari *Anda*, dengan cara apa pun yang mereka sukai.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: Ini Kamis di Columbus dan Anda membutuhkan jaket untuk perjalanan pada hari Sabtu.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: Anda melihat satu di iklan Instagram seharga $129.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: Anda ketuk, tetapi pengiriman mengatakan "tiba Selasa" — terlambat.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: Kemudian halaman produk menunjukkan opsi kedua: **Stok di Easton Town Center — ambil hari ini.** Anda membelinya secara online, mendapatkan kode QR melalui email, parkir, berjalan ke konter pengambilan, dan Anda keluar dalam empat menit.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: Lihat apa yang baru saja terjadi secara operasional.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: Penjualan itu dipesan sebagai pesanan digital, tetapi unitnya dikeluarkan dari rak toko.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: Seorang karyawan toko mendapat tugas pengambilan pada pemindai genggam, menarik jaket, dan menyusunnya di area pengambilan.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: Poin loyalitas Anda diposting ke akun yang sama yang Anda gunakan secara online.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: Dan jika tidak pas, Anda dapat menjatuhkannya di lokasi mana pun — di mana ia kembali ke inventaris yang dapat dijual yang dapat dilihat situs web lagi dengan segera.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: Bagian terakhir itu adalah mengapa pengecer mendorong ini dengan sangat keras.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: Ini bukan hanya kenyamanan pelanggan; ini adalah **pemanfaatan aset**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: Toko di area metro adalah inventaris yang sudah duduk dekat dengan pelanggan.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: Menggunakannya sebagai pusat pemenuhan mini membuat pengiriman cepat lebih murah daripada mengirim semuanya dari satu pusat distribusi ratusan mil jauhnya, dan perjalanan pengambilan menghasilkan lalu lintas pejalan kaki yang sering berubah menjadi item tambahan saat checkout.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: Target, misalnya, telah secara publik melaporkan bahwa tokonya memenuhi sebagian besar pesanan digitalnya.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: Biayanya sama nyatanya.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: Tenaga kerja toko ditarik dari lantai penjualan untuk mengambil dan mengemas.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: Akurasi inventaris harus tinggi, karena pesanan yang dibatalkan pada sesuatu yang sudah Anda tagihkan adalah salah satu cara tercepat untuk kehilangan pelanggan.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: Dan akuntansinya menjadi canggung: jika penjualannya digital tetapi toko yang melakukan pekerjaan, angka siapa itu?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan itu — **konflik saluran** — menghentikan lebih banyak proyek omnichannel daripada teknologi yang pernah ada.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.tr: 1. Multichannel berarti beberapa pintu terpisah ke merek; omnichannel berarti satu pengalaman terintegrasi, didefinisikan dari sisi pelanggan daripada sisi bagan organisasi.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. Ini berjalan pada tiga bagian sistem perpipaan: visibilitas inventaris bersama, profil pelanggan terpadu, dan logika pemenuhan yang fleksibel.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. Pembayarannya adalah kenyamanan ditambah penggunaan aset toko yang lebih baik; harganya adalah tenaga kerja toko, akurasi inventaris ketat, dan pertarungan internal atas kredit penjualan.

segments.tr: 1. **在庫の可視化。**何が手元にあり、どこにあるかの1つの共有ビュー。ウェブサイトがシンシナティの店舗にある3つのジャケットを見ることができなければ、それらを販売することはできない。

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **顧客データ。**チャネル全体での1つのプロフィール—購入、ロイヤルティポイント、返品、保存されたカート。そうでなければ、フロアのスタッフは顧客が20分前にオンラインで何をしたのかわからない。

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **フルフィルメントロジック。**注文ごとにどのノードがそれに対応するかを決定するルール：配送センター、近くの店舗、または直接発送するベンダー。

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: 3つをうまくやれば、ピックアップ、カーブサイド、エンドレスアイル、そして問題のない返品を提供できる。

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: それらをスキップしたら、「オムニチャネル」はただ店舗ロケーター機能を持つウェブサイトに過ぎない。

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: ここで知る価値のある2つの行動用語がある。

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **ショールーミング**は店舗で商品を検査してからオンラインで購入すること、しばしば競合他社から。

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **ウェブルーミング**はその逆：オンラインで調査してから対面で購入する。

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: オムニチャネルはショールーミングに対する部分的な防御的回答である—顧客があなたの通路に立ちながら携帯で価格確認するつもりなら、あなたは彼らが*あなたから*、彼らが好む方法で購入することを願う。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活で

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: コロンバスの木曜日で、土曜日の旅行用のジャケットが必要だ。

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: Instagramの広告で$129のジャケットを見つける。

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: タップして進むが、配送が「火曜日到着」と表示される—遅すぎる。

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: その後、商品ページは2番目のオプションを表示する：**Easton Town Centerで在庫あり—本日受け取り可能。**オンラインで購入し、メールでQRコードを取得し、駐車して、ピックアップカウンターまで歩いて、4分で完了する。

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: 運営上、何が起こったかを見てみよう。

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: 販売はデジタル注文として記録されたが、ユニットは店舗の棚から出た。

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: 店舗従業員はハンドヘルドスキャナーでピックタスクを受け取り、ジャケットを引き出し、ピックアップエリアにステージングした。

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: ロイヤルティポイントは、オンラインで使用するのと同じアカウントに記録される。

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: そしてもしサイズが合わなければ、任意の場所にドロップできる—そこでウェブサイトがすぐに再度見ることができる販売可能な在庫に戻る。

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: その最後の部分が、小売業者がこれを強く推し進める理由である。

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: これは単なる顧客の利便性ではない。それは**資産利用**である。

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: 都市部の店舗は既に顧客に近い在庫である。

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: それらをミニフルフィルメントセンターとして使用することで、数百マイル離れた1つの配送センターからすべてを発送するより、迅速な配送を安くすることができ、ピックアップトリップは足の運びを生成し、それはしばしばチェックアウト時の追加アイテムに変わる。

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: 例えば、Targetは、その店舗がその大多数のデジタル注文を満たしていることを公開報告している。

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: コストは同じくらい現実的である。

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: 店舗労働力は販売フロアから引き出され、ピックアンドパック作業に従事する。

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: 在庫精度は高いままでなければならない。既に請求した物の注文キャンセルは、顧客を失う最も速い方法の1つだからだ。

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: そして会計がぎこちなくなる：販売がデジタルだったが店舗が仕事をした場合、それは誰の数字か？

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: その質問— **チャネル間の対立** —はテクノロジーよりも多くのオムニチャネルプロジェクトを停滞させる。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行で復習

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. マルチチャネルはブランドへの複数の別々の入口を意味し、オムニチャネルは1つの統合されたエクスペリエンスを意味し、組織図ではなく顧客側から定義される。

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. 共有在庫の可視化、統一された顧客プロフィール、柔軟なフルフィルメントロジックの3つで実行される。

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. 報酬は利便性とより良い店舗資産の活用；対価は店舗労働力、厳密な在庫精度、そして販売クレジットを巡る社内の戦い。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己確認クイズ

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** 小売業者はウェブサイトと200の店舗を運営している。

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: 各自が独立した在庫プールを維持し、ウェブ注文は配送センターからのみ発送できる。

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: これは最も適切に説明されると：

segments.src: A) Omnichannel  B) Multichannel  C) Ship-from-store  D) Endless aisle
segments.tr: A) オムニチャネル  B) マルチチャネル  C) 店舗配送  D) エンドレスアイル

segments.src: **2.** True or False — A customer who researches a product online and then buys it at a physical store is *showrooming*.
segments.tr: **2.** 正誤問題—オンラインで製品を調査してから物理的な店舗で購入する顧客は*ショールーミング*である。

segments.src: **3.** Which is the most direct operational risk of using stores to fulfill online orders?
segments.tr: **3.** 店舗を使用してオンライン注文を満たす場合、最も直接的な運営上のリスクは何か？

segments.src: A) Higher advertising costs
segments.tr: A) 広告コストが高い

segments.src: B) Cancelled orders caused by inaccurate store inventory counts
segments.tr: B) 不正確な店舗在庫数によって引き起こされたキャンセルされた注文

segments.src: C) Fewer SKUs listed on the website
segments.tr: C) ウェブサイトに掲載されるSKUが少ない

segments.src: D) Losing loyalty program members
segments.tr: D) ロイヤルティプログラムメンバーを失う

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **オムニチャネル** — チャネルが在庫、顧客データ、フルフィルメントを共有するため、買い物客は別々のビジネスではなく1つのブランドを経験する運営モデル。

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **マルチチャネル** — 各自が独自の在庫とシステムを持つ、独立して運営される複数のチャネルを通じた販売。

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (オンライン・トゥ・オフライン)** — アプリで購入して店舗でピックアップするなど、オンライン需要を物理的な場所に接続し、また戻すこと。

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **店舗フルフィルメント (BOPIS / カーブサイド / 店舗配送)** — 顧客が収集するか、店舗が発送するかを問わず、店舗在庫からオンライン注文に対応すること。

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **チャネル間の対立** — チャネルが同じ顧客、マージン、または販売クレジットを巡って競争するときの内部摩擦。

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — separate inventory pools and no store fulfillment means the channels coexist but aren't integrated.
segments.tr: *回答：1) B—独立した在庫プールと店舗フルフィルメントがないことは、チャネルが共存するが統合されていないことを意味する。

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) 誤り—それはウェブルーミングです。ショールーミングは店舗で検査してオンラインで購入することです。

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B—店舗の在庫数は通常、配送センターのそれより正確性が低いため、実際にはない商品を約束することは、顧客が既に支払った後のキャンセルにつながる。*

de.title: [Retailing 101 #12] Ihr Nachbarschaftsgeschäft ist jetzt auch ein Lager

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > Omnichannel-Einzelhandel bedeutet, dass der Kunde eine Marke anstelle von vier separaten Kanälen kauft — was nur funktioniert, wenn Bestand, Kundendaten und Fulfillment hinter den Kulissen zusammengefügt sind.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Das heutige Konzept

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler dachten früher in Kanälen.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: Läden waren ein Geschäft, die Website ein anderes, der Katalog oder das Call Center ein drittes.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: Jedes hatte seinen eigenen Bestandspool, seine eigene Preisgestaltung, manchmal seine eigene Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung und seinen eigenen Chef.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: Das ist **Multichannel**-Einzelhandel: mehrere Zugänge zu derselben Marke, aber die Türen sprechen nicht miteinander.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **Omnichannel** dreht den Blickwinkel um.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: Anstatt zu fragen "Wie hat jeder Kanal abgeschnitten?", fragt es "Wie sieht das aus der Perspektive des Kunden aus?"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: Ein Käufer denkt nie *Ich bin jetzt im mobilen Kanal.* Sie sehen eine Anzeige auf einem Telefon, lesen Bewertungen auf einem Laptop, berühren den Artikel in einem Geschäft und kaufen auf die Weise, die in diesem Moment am einfachsten ist.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: Omnichannel ist das Betriebsmodell, das alle diese Kontaktpunkte wie einen Laden verhalten lässt.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: Die gebräuchliche Abkürzung ist **O2O — online zu offline** und wieder zurück.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: Online-Nachfrage zieht Menschen an physische Standorte (in der App bestellen, an der Theke abholen), und physische Standorte bedienen Online-Nachfrage (eine Bestellung aus dem Lagerbestand versenden, eine Web-Rückgabe am Servicedesk entgegennehmen).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: Der schwierige Teil ist nicht die Storefront.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: Es ist die Infrastruktur.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: Drei Dinge müssen integriert werden:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **Bestandssichtbarkeit.** Eine gemeinsame Ansicht dessen, was auf Lager ist und wo. Wenn die Website die drei Jacken, die in einem Geschäft in Cincinnati sind, nicht sehen kann, kann sie sie nicht verkaufen.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **Kundendaten.** Ein Profil über alle Kanäle hinweg — Käufe, Prämienpunkte, Retouren, gespeicherte Warenkörbe. Ansonsten hat der Mitarbeiter im Geschäft keine Ahnung, was der Kunde vor zwanzig Minuten online getan hat.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **Fulfillment-Logik.** Regeln, die von Bestellung zu Bestellung entscheiden, welcher Knoten sie bedient: ein Verteilzentrum, ein nahegelegenes Geschäft oder ein Anbieter, der direkt versendet.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie diese drei richtig machen, können Sie Abholung, Bordsteinservice, Endlosgänge und problemlose Retouren anbieten.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: Überspringen Sie sie und "Omnichannel" ist nur eine Website mit einem Geschäftsfinder.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: Zwei Verhaltensbegriffe sind hier wissenswert.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **Showrooming** ist das Inspizieren eines Artikels in einem Geschäft und dann der Online-Kauf, oft von einem Konkurrenten.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **Webrooming** ist das Gegenteil: Online recherchieren, dann persönlich kaufen.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: Omnichannel ist teilweise eine defensive Antwort auf Showrooming — wenn ein Kunde die Preise auf seinem Telefon überprüfen wird, während er in Ihrem Gang steht, möchten Sie lieber, dass er bei *Ihnen* kauft, auf welche Weise auch immer er bevorzugt.

segments.tr: ## Im täglichen Leben

segments.tr: Es ist Donnerstag in Columbus und Sie brauchen eine Jacke für eine Reise am Samstag.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.

segments.tr: Der Verkauf wurde als digitale Bestellung verbucht, aber die Einheit kam aus einem Ladenregal.

segments.tr: Ein Ladenbeamter erhielt eine Pick-Aufgabe auf einem tragbaren Scanner, zog die Jacke und stellte sie in den Abholbereich.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: Der letzte Teil ist der Grund, warum Einzelhändler dies so aggressiv fördern.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: Es ist nicht nur Kundenfreundlichkeit; es ist **Vermögensnutzung**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: Geschäfte in Ballungsräumen sind Bestand, der bereits in der Nähe des Kunden sitzt.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: Die Bestandsgenauigkeit muss hoch sein, da eine stornierte Bestellung für etwas, das Sie bereits in Rechnung gestellt haben, einer der schnellsten Wege ist, einen Kunden zu verlieren.

segments.tr: Und die Buchhaltung wird schwierig: Wenn der Verkauf digital war, aber der Laden die Arbeit machte, wessen Zahl ist es?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: Diese Frage — **Kanalkonflikt** — stoppt mehr Omnichannel-Projekte als die Technologie jemals tut.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Dreilineige Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. Multichannel bedeutet mehrere separate Türen zu einer Marke; Omnichannel bedeutet eine integrierte Erfahrung, definiert von der Kundenseite aus, nicht vom Organigramm.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. Es läuft auf drei Infrastrukturkomponenten: gemeinsame Bestandssichtbarkeit, ein einheitliches Kundenprofil und flexible Fulfillment-Logik.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. Der Gewinn ist Bequemlichkeit plus bessere Nutzung von Geschäftsvermögen; der Preis ist Ladenarbeit, strikte Bestandsgenauigkeit und interne Kämpfe um Verkaufsguthaben.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Selbst-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** A retailer runs a website and 200 stores.
segments.tr: **1.** Ein Einzelhändler betreibt eine Website und 200 Geschäfte.

segments.src: Each keeps a separate inventory pool, and web orders can only ship from the distribution center.
segments.tr: Jedes behält einen separaten Bestandspool, und Web-Bestellungen können nur vom Verteilzentrum versendet werden.

segments.src: This is best described as:
segments.tr: Dies wird am besten beschrieben als:

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Heutige Begriffe

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — An operating model where channels share inventory, customer data, and fulfillment so the shopper experiences one brand instead of separate businesses.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — Ein Betriebsmodell, bei dem Kanäle Bestand, Kundendaten und Fulfillment teilen, sodass der Käufer eine Marke anstatt separate Unternehmen erfährt.

segments.src: - **Multichannel** — Selling through several channels that run independently, each with its own inventory and systems.
segments.tr: - **Multichannel** — Verkauf über mehrere unabhängig laufende Kanäle, jeder mit eigenem Bestand und Systemen.

segments.src: - **O2O (Online to Offline)** — Connecting online demand to physical locations and back, such as buying on an app and picking up at a store.
segments.tr: - **O2O (Online zu Offline)** — Verbindung von Online-Nachfrage mit physischen Standorten und zurück, wie das Kaufen in einer App und Abholen im Geschäft.

segments.src: - **Store fulfillment (BOPIS / curbside / ship-from-store)** — Serving an online order out of store stock, whether the customer collects it or the store ships it.
segments.tr: - **Ladenerfüllung (BOPIS / Bordsteinservice / Versand aus dem Geschäft)** — Erfüllung einer Online-Bestellung aus dem Lagerbestand, ob der Kunde es abholt oder der Laden es versendet.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — Internal friction when channels compete over the same customer, margin, or credit for a sale.
segments.tr: - **Kanalkonflikt** — Interne Reibung, wenn Kanäle um denselben Kunden, Marge oder Verkaufsguthaben konkurrieren.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — separate inventory pools and no store fulfillment means the channels coexist but aren't integrated.
segments.tr: *Antworten: 1) B — separate Bestandspools und keine Ladenerfüllung bedeuten, dass die Kanäle nebeneinander existieren, aber nicht integriert sind.

segments.src: 2) False — that's webrooming; showrooming is inspecting in store and buying online.
segments.tr: 2) Falsch — das ist Webrooming; Showrooming ist die Besichtigung im Geschäft und der Online-Kauf.

segments.src: 3) B — store inventory counts are typically less accurate than a distribution center's, so promising a unit that isn't really there leads to cancellations after the customer has already paid.*
segments.tr: 3) B — Bestandszählungen im Geschäft sind typischerweise weniger genau als die eines Verteilzentrums, daher führt das Versprechen einer Einheit, die nicht wirklich vorhanden ist, zu Stornierungen, nachdem der Kunde bereits bezahlt hat.*

vi.title: [Retailing 101 #12] Cửa hàng khu phố của bạn cũng là một kho hàng bây giờ

segments.src: > Omnichannel retail means the customer shops one brand instead of four separate channels — which only works if inventory, customer data, and fulfillment are stitched together behind the scenes.
segments.tr: > Bán lẻ omnichannel có nghĩa là khách hàng mua sắm một thương hiệu thay vì bốn kênh riêng biệt — điều này chỉ hoạt động nếu hàng tồn kho, dữ liệu khách hàng và thực hiện đơn hàng được kết nối với nhau ở hậu trường.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: Retailers used to think in channels.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ từng suy nghĩ theo kênh.

segments.src: Stores were one business, the website another, the catalog or call center a third.
segments.tr: Các cửa hàng là một hoạt động kinh doanh, trang web là một hoạt động khác, danh mục hoặc trung tâm gọi điện là hoạt động thứ ba.

segments.src: Each had its own inventory pool, its own pricing, sometimes its own P&L and its own boss.
segments.tr: Mỗi cái có nhóm hàng tồn kho riêng, giá cả riêng, đôi khi P&L riêng và sếp riêng.

segments.src: That's **multichannel** retailing: several doors into the same brand, but the doors don't talk to each other.
segments.tr: Đó là **multichannel** bán lẻ: nhiều cửa vào cùng một thương hiệu, nhưng các cửa không giao tiếp với nhau.

segments.src: **Omnichannel** flips the point of view.
segments.tr: **Omnichannel** lật ngược quan điểm.

segments.src: Instead of asking "how did each channel perform?", it asks "what does this look like from where the customer is standing?"
segments.tr: Thay vì hỏi "mỗi kênh hoạt động như thế nào?", nó hỏi "điều này trông như thế nào từ vị trí khách hàng đang đứng?"

segments.src: A shopper never thinks *I'm in the mobile channel now.* They see an ad on a phone, read reviews on a laptop, touch the item in a store, and buy whichever way is easiest at that moment.
segments.tr: Người mua sắm không bao giờ nghĩ *Tôi đang ở kênh di động bây giờ.* Họ thấy quảng cáo trên điện thoại, đọc bình luận trên máy tính xách tay, chạm vào mặt hàng trong cửa hàng và mua theo cách nào dễ nhất vào thời điểm đó.

segments.src: Omnichannel is the operating model that makes all those touchpoints behave like one store.
segments.tr: Omnichannel là mô hình hoạt động khiến tất cả những điểm chạm đó hoạt động như một cửa hàng.

segments.src: The common shorthand is **O2O — online to offline**, and back again.
segments.tr: Từ viết tắt phổ biến là **O2O — trực tuyến sang ngoại tuyến**, rồi quay lại.

segments.src: Online demand pulls people into physical locations (order on the app, pick up at the counter), and physical locations serve online demand (ship an order out of store stock, take a web return at the service desk).
segments.tr: Nhu cầu trực tuyến kéo người dân vào các địa điểm vật lý (đặt hàng trên ứng dụng, nhận tại quầy), và các địa điểm vật lý phục vụ nhu cầu trực tuyến (gửi đơn hàng từ kho của cửa hàng, nhận lại web tại bàn phục vụ).

segments.src: The hard part isn't the storefront.
segments.tr: Phần khó không phải là mặt tiền cửa hàng.

segments.src: It's the plumbing.
segments.tr: Đó là cơ sở hạ tầng.

segments.src: Three things have to be integrated:
segments.tr: Ba điều phải được tích hợp:

segments.src: 1. **Inventory visibility.** One shared view of what's on hand and where. If the website can't see the three jackets sitting in a store in Cincinnati, it can't sell them.
segments.tr: 1. **Khả năng hiển thị hàng tồn kho.** Một chế độ xem chia sẻ về những gì đang có và ở đâu. Nếu trang web không thể nhìn thấy ba chiếc áo khoác đang ở cửa hàng ở Cincinnati, nó không thể bán chúng.

segments.src: 2. **Customer data.** One profile across channels — purchases, loyalty points, returns, saved carts. Otherwise the associate on the floor has no idea what the customer did online twenty minutes ago.
segments.tr: 2. **Dữ liệu khách hàng.** Một hồ sơ trên các kênh — mua hàng, điểm trung thành, lợi nhuận, giỏ hàng đã lưu. Nếu không, nhân viên trên sàn không biết khách hàng đã làm gì trực tuyến hai mươi phút trước.

segments.src: 3. **Fulfillment logic.** Rules that decide, order by order, which node serves it: a distribution center, a nearby store, or a vendor shipping direct.
segments.tr: 3. **Logic thực hiện đơn hàng.** Các quy tắc quyết định, từng đơn hàng, nút nào phục vụ nó: trung tâm phân phối, cửa hàng gần đó hoặc nhà cung cấp gửi trực tiếp.

segments.src: Get those three right and you can offer pickup, curbside, endless aisle, and painless returns.
segments.tr: Làm đúng ba cái đó và bạn có thể cung cấp nhận hàng, lề đường, hàng hóa vô tận và lợi nhuận không đau đớn.

segments.src: Skip them and "omnichannel" is just a website with a store locator on it.
segments.tr: Bỏ qua chúng và "omnichannel" chỉ là một trang web có trình định vị cửa hàng.

segments.src: Two behavior terms are worth knowing here.
segments.tr: Hai thuật ngữ hành vi đáng biết ở đây.

segments.src: **Showrooming** is inspecting an item in a store and then buying it online, often from a competitor.
segments.tr: **Showrooming** là kiểm tra một mặt hàng trong cửa hàng rồi mua nó trực tuyến, thường từ một đối thủ cạnh tranh.

segments.src: **Webrooming** is the reverse: researching online, then buying in person.
segments.tr: **Webrooming** là ngược lại: nghiên cứu trực tuyến, sau đó mua trực tiếp.

segments.src: Omnichannel is partly a defensive answer to showrooming — if a customer is going to price-check on their phone while standing in your aisle, you'd rather they buy from *you*, in whatever way they prefer.
segments.tr: Omnichannel là một phần câu trả lời phòng chống showrooming — nếu khách hàng sắp kiểm tra giá trên điện thoại của họ khi đứng trong lối đi của bạn, bạn thà họ mua từ *bạn*, theo bất kỳ cách nào họ thích.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong cuộc sống hàng ngày

segments.src: It's Thursday in Columbus and you need a jacket for a trip on Saturday.
segments.tr: Hôm nay là thứ Năm ở Columbus và bạn cần một chiếc áo khoác cho một chuyến đi vào thứ Bảy.

segments.src: You spot one in an Instagram ad for $129.
segments.tr: Bạn phát hiện một cái trong quảng cáo Instagram với giá $129.

segments.src: You tap through, but shipping says "arrives Tuesday" — too late.
segments.tr: Bạn nhấp vào, nhưng vận chuyển nói "tới thứ Ba" — quá muộn.

segments.src: Then the product page shows a second option: **In stock at Easton Town Center — pick up today.** You buy it online, get a QR code by email, park, walk to the pickup counter, and you're out in four minutes.
segments.tr: Sau đó, trang sản phẩm hiển thị một tùy chọn thứ hai: **Có sẵn tại Easton Town Center — nhận hôm nay.** Bạn mua nó trực tuyến, nhận mã QR qua email, đỗ xe, đi bộ đến quầy nhận hàng và bạn ra ngoài trong bốn phút.

segments.src: Look at what just happened operationally.
segments.tr: Nhìn vào những gì vừa xảy ra về hoạt động.

segments.src: The sale was booked as a digital order, but the unit came off a store shelf.
segments.tr: Việc bán hàng được ghi nhận như một đơn hàng kỹ thuật số, nhưng đơn vị xuất phát từ kệ cửa hàng.

segments.src: A store employee got a pick task on a handheld scanner, pulled the jacket, and staged it in the pickup area.
segments.tr: Một nhân viên cửa hàng nhận được một nhiệm vụ trên máy quét cầm tay, kéo áo khoác và đặt nó ở khu vực nhận hàng.

segments.src: Your loyalty points posted to the same account you use online.
segments.tr: Điểm trung thành của bạn được đăng vào cùng tài khoản bạn sử dụng trực tuyến.

segments.src: And if it doesn't fit, you can drop it at any location — where it goes back into sellable inventory that the website can immediately see again.
segments.tr: Và nếu nó không vừa, bạn có thể bỏ nó ở bất kỳ địa điểm nào — nơi nó quay trở lại hàng tồn kho có thể bán được mà trang web có thể nhìn thấy ngay lập tức.

segments.src: That last part is why retailers push this so hard.
segments.tr: Phần cuối cùng đó là lý do tại sao các nhà bán lẻ thúc đẩy điều này rất mạnh.

segments.src: It isn't only customer convenience; it's **asset utilization**.
segments.tr: Không chỉ là sự tiện lợi của khách hàng; đó là **tối ưu hóa tài sản**.

segments.src: Stores in metro areas are inventory that already sits close to the customer.
segments.tr: Các cửa hàng ở các khu vực đô thị là hàng tồn kho đã gần với khách hàng.

segments.src: Using them as mini-fulfillment centers makes fast delivery cheaper than shipping everything from one distribution center hundreds of miles away, and pickup trips generate foot traffic that often turns into an extra item at checkout.
segments.tr: Sử dụng chúng làm các trung tâm thực hiện đơn hàng mini làm cho giao hàng nhanh rẻ hơn so với gửi mọi thứ từ một trung tâm phân phối cách xa hàng trăm dặm và các chuyến đi nhận hàng tạo ra lưu lượng khách đi bộ thường biến thành một mặt hàng bổ sung khi thanh toán.

segments.src: Target, for instance, has publicly reported that its stores fulfill the large majority of its digital orders.
segments.tr: Ví dụ, Target đã công khai báo cáo rằng các cửa hàng của nó thực hiện phần lớn đơn hàng kỹ thuật số của nó.

segments.src: The costs are just as real.
segments.tr: Các chi phí cũng thực tế.

segments.src: Store labor gets pulled off the sales floor to pick and pack.
segments.tr: Lao động cửa hàng được kéo ra khỏi sàn bán hàng để lựa chọn và đóng gói.

segments.src: Inventory accuracy has to be high, because a cancelled order on something you already charged for is one of the fastest ways to lose a customer.
segments.tr: Độ chính xác của hàng tồn kho phải cao, bởi vì một đơn hàng bị hủy trên thứ gì đó bạn đã tính phí là một trong những cách nhanh nhất để mất khách hàng.

segments.src: And the accounting gets awkward: if the sale was digital but the store did the work, whose number is it?
segments.tr: Và kế toán trở nên khó xử: nếu bán hàng là kỹ thuật số nhưng cửa hàng đã làm công việc, số của ai là nó?

segments.src: That question — **channel conflict** — stalls more omnichannel projects than the technology ever does.
segments.tr: Câu hỏi đó — **xung đột kênh** — làm trì hoãn nhiều dự án omnichannel hơn công nghệ từng làm.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt ba dòng

segments.src: 1. Multichannel means several separate doors into a brand; omnichannel means one integrated experience, defined from the customer's side rather than the org chart's.
segments.tr: 1. Multichannel có nghĩa là nhiều cửa riêng biệt vào một thương hiệu; omnichannel có nghĩa là một trải nghiệm tích hợp, được xác định từ phía khách hàng chứ không phải từ sơ đồ tổ chức.

segments.src: 2. It runs on three pieces of plumbing: shared inventory visibility, a unified customer profile, and flexible fulfillment logic.
segments.tr: 2. Nó chạy trên ba phần cơ sở hạ tầng: khả năng hiển thị hàng tồn kho chia sẻ, hồ sơ khách hàng thống nhất và logic thực hiện đơn hàng linh hoạt.

segments.src: 3. The payoff is convenience plus better use of store assets; the price is store labor, strict inventory accuracy, and internal fights over sales credit.
segments.tr: 3. Phần thưởng là sự tiện lợi cộng với việc sử dụng tốt hơn các tài sản cửa hàng; giá là lao động cửa hàng, độ chính xác hàng tồn kho nghiêm ngặt và tranh chấp nội bộ về tín dụng bán hàng.
